rowReviews.assessment: Spending the whole allowance as a single batch is the same all-at-once sense as canonical all in one go. The brief now includes spending/using a specified whole amount and avoids implying speed or ease; detector matches.

rowReviews.assessment: Art forms becoming less visible or central is the same marginalisation image as canonical community groups. The brief allows quiet loss of cultural attention and the detector matches the adverbial variant without changing the owner outcome.
